seo.title: Security
seo.description: Explore Interfy's security, privacy, and compliance architecture: encryption, access control, Multi-AZ high availability, and ISO, LGPD, GDPR, and SOC 2 certifications.

hero.description: Interfy was built with the highest standards of security, privacy, and compliance to protect what matters most: your company's data.

items.title: Workspace isolation
items.description: Every customer works in an isolated environment, ensuring full privacy and security.

items.title: Customer-specific database
items.description: Data stored in a dedicated database per customer, with no sharing.

items.title: Advanced encryption
items.description: Data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).

items.title: Access control (RBAC)
items.description: Granular permissions by role, group, area, and sensitivity level.

items.title: Corporate authentication
items.description: SSO, SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, AD/LDAP, and MFA for secure, unified access.

items.title: IP Blocking
items.description: Access restriction by IP or IP range to protect your environment.

items.title: Logs and audit trails
items.description: Complete record of every action with an immutable, searchable audit trail.

items.title: 24/7 Monitoring
items.description: Continuous monitoring of infrastructure, applications, and security.

items.title: Automatic backup
items.description: Encrypted, automatic backups with configurable retention.

items.title: Disaster Recovery
items.description: Disaster recovery plan with geographic replication.

items.title: Private Storage
items.description: Optional private storage for on-premise or Dedicated environments.

items.title: Unlimited scalability
items.description: Elastic infrastructure that grows with your business without compromising performance.

items.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
items.description: Information Security Management System certified to the international standard.

items.title: HIPAA Ready
items.description: Architecture, controls, and processes ready to support environments handling health information (ePHI) in the US.

items.title: LGPD
items.description: Compliant with Brazil's General Data Protection Law.

items.title: GDPR
items.description: Compliant with the EU General Data Protection Regulation.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II
items.description: Rigorous controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

items.title: Other standards
items.description: Policies and controls aligned with the industry's most demanding market standards.
